Here are the findings for each question, all in repo `github.com/sg-evals/gcc--releases_gcc-14.2.0`:

---

**1. Master pass ordering list**
[`gcc/passes.def`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/gcc--releases_gcc-14.2.0/-/blob/gcc/passes.def) — Uses `NEXT_PASS`, `PUSH_INSERT_PASSES_WITHIN`, `POP_INSERT_PASSES`, and `TERMINATE_PASS_LIST` macros to define the complete ordered pipeline for `all_lowering_passes`, `all_small_ipa_passes`, `all_regular_ipa_passes`, `all_lto_gen_passes`, `all_late_ipa_passes`, and `all_passes`.

**2. Pass manager implementation**
[`gcc/passes.cc`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/gcc--releases_gcc-14.2.0/-/blob/gcc/passes.cc) — Implements `pass_manager`, including `finish_optimization_passes`, `register_pass`, and pass execution orchestration.

**3. Base class and pass manager interface**
- [`gcc/tree-pass.h`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/gcc--releases_gcc-14.2.0/-/blob/gcc/tree-pass.h) — Defines `opt_pass` (base class), `gimple_opt_pass`, `rtl_opt_pass`, `simple_ipa_opt_pass`, `ipa_opt_pass_d`, and `pass_data`.
- [`gcc/pass_manager.h`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/gcc--releases_gcc-14.2.0/-/blob/gcc/pass_manager.h) — Declares the `pass_manager` class interface with methods like `finish_optimization_passes`, `execute_early_local_passes`, etc.

**4. Concrete GIMPLE DCE pass**
[`gcc/tree-ssa-dce.cc`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/gcc--releases_gcc-14.2.0/-/blob/gcc/tree-ssa-dce.cc) — Implements `pass_dce` (simple SSA dead code elimination extending `gimple_opt_pass`) and `pass_cd_dce` (control-dependence DCE). Factory: `make_pass_dce()`.

**5. Pass registration macros and tree-SSA declarations**
[`gcc/tree-pass.h`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/gcc--releases_gcc-14.2.0/-/blob/gcc/tree-pass.h) — Contains the `NEXT_PASS` macro infrastructure and all `extern gimple_opt_pass *make_pass_*()` declarations for tree-SSA passes.
